item.title: [New] Teams meetings get granular Conditional Access through authentication contexts: preview late November 2026, GA January 2027
item.description:
Sensitive meetings (board, M&A, incident bridges) can be gated by MFA or device compliance per meeting instead of tenant-wide, and the new authentication contexts become part of the CA estate the SOC monitors.

Teams · Decide which authentication contexts Teams should be allowed to request, create them and their CA policies in report-only first, and add the new contexts to Conditional Access change monitoring.

item.title: [Due in 3 days] Final reminder: the MemberOf rule operator stops processing on 3 November 2026 in dynamic groups, dynamic administrative units and entitlement auto-assignment policies
item.description:
A frozen dynamic group keeps leavers inside every Conditional Access policy, administrative-unit scope and licence it governs; the failure is silent, because membership simply stops changing.

Entra · deadline 2026-11-03 · Export dynamic groups and administrative units, find rules containing MemberOf, replace them with supported operators or assigned membership, and check entitlement auto-assignment policies before 3 November.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Due in 4 days] From 4 November every default user can create agent blueprints unless 'Users can create agent blueprints' is set to No
item.description:
A default-on permission for every member user to create a new kind of workload identity widens the app-registration surface that consent-phishing and persistence techniques already abuse, and tenants that locked down app registration are not covered by that setting.

Entra · deadline 2026-11-04 · Decide before 4 November: set 'Users can create agent blueprints' to No unless there is a business case, keep Agent ID Developer as the delegated path, and add agent blueprint creation by non-admins to the app-registration detections.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Due in 4 days] Entra stops auto-granting AgentIdentity.CreateAsManager to agent blueprints from 4 November; app-only agents that create their own identities need explicit admin consent or get 403
item.description:
Until now every agent blueprint could mint agent identities without any admin approval and without a visible grant. After the change that authority becomes an auditable, revocable app-role assignment, so the grant itself becomes something to monitor.

Entra · deadline 2026-11-04 · Before 4 November, filter the Entra audit log on ApplicationManagement / Add Service Principal where the initiator is an Application and the target an agent identity; grant AgentIdentity.CreateAsManager explicitly (from 16 October) only to the blueprints that need it, and alert on new grants of it afterwards.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Due in 3 days] Final reminder: the MemberOf rule operator stops processing on 3 November, and dynamic groups built on it freeze in their last state
item.description:
A group that stops recalculating does not fail loudly: it keeps whoever was in it on 3 November. A leaver stays in a group that grants access or a licence, a joiner never arrives in a group a Conditional Access policy targets, and an administrative unit stops following the population it was meant to scope. Nothing alerts, because nothing errors.

Entra · deadline 2026-11-03 · Query dynamic groups and administrative units for membership rules containing memberOf, list which Conditional Access policies, access packages and licence assignments target them, and replace each rule or convert the group to assigned membership before 3 November.

item.title: [New] Six CopilotCostManagement permissions appear in Microsoft's 27 October permission sync, covering Copilot spending policies and per-user usage reports
item.description:
CopilotCostManagement-UserData.Read.All reads per-user Copilot usage details and sessions; the ReadWrite permissions let an app change spending policies and which groups they apply to. Neither is in Microsoft's permissions reference yet.

Graph · No tenant action until the permissions reach the service; once they do, add the CopilotCostManagement.* names to the consent watch list and alert on any grant of the ReadWrite or UserData permissions.

item.title: [New] Conditional Access policy plans (preview) are now documented: shared targeting and exclusions defined once, inherited by every rule, and a plan-level exclusion no rule can remove
item.description:
Sign-in logs will show plan rules as separate entries, and a plan-level exclusion silently applies to every rule; location-conditioned plans lose continuous access evaluation's instant IP enforcement during preview.

Entra · Before adopting plans, decide where emergency-access exclusions live, make sure sign-in log parsing and CA reporting handle rule entries, and keep location-based policies outside plans while the one-hour-token limitation applies.
